description: Monitoring operations frontend aligned to actual backend API surface. Unsupported workflows fail closed.

routes.label: Overview
routes.missingApiDependency: Dashboard returns stub; no aggregate alert/automation KPIs available and the stub is not called.
routes.safeFallback: Source health from live Sources API; all alert/automation KPIs labelled unavailable (never zeroes).

routes.label: Alerts
routes.missingApiDependency: GET /monitoring/alerts/ collection endpoint is not registered.
routes.safeFallback: Clear 'Alert list API unavailable' state. No requests to unsupported URL.

routes.label: Alert Detail
routes.safeFallback: Only serializer-exposed fields rendered (alert_number, title, severity, status, source_name, event_count).

routes.label: Sources
routes.missingApiDependency: Source create (POST /monitoring/sources/) and edit (PATCH/PUT /monitoring/sources/<id>/) not registered.
routes.safeFallback: Read-only list/detail; explicit 'create/edit not available' message; no create/edit form.

routes.label: Automation policies
routes.safeFallback: Read-only policy preview; save/delete disabled; 'Policy administration API not available' message.

permissions.system_admin: full Monitoring administration (sources list/detail/enable/disable/rotate-secret/test, alert retrieve/actions, dashboard, policies preview)
permissions.it_manager: operational visibility and governed actions (alert actions where permitted)
permissions.it_support: Alert and Ticket operations per API permissions (alert actions where permitted)

apiGaps: GET /monitoring/dashboard/ returns a stub (no aggregate alert metrics); frontend does not call it.
GET /monitoring/alerts/ list endpoint is not registered (only retrieve by id).
POST /monitoring/sources/ create endpoint is not registered.
PATCH/PUT /monitoring/sources/<id>/ edit endpoint is not registered.
No policy CRUD endpoints exist for MonitoringAutomationPolicy. Proposed: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /monitoring/automation-policies/.
Alert sub-actions events/history/ticket/create-ticket/update-ticket are registered in urls.py but have no corresponding methods on MonitoringAlertViewSet.
Source detail serializer (MonitoringSourceListSerializer) does not expose allowlist/grace-period write fields; only list fields are returned.
